forge_capabilities.title: Capabilities
forge_capabilities.description: Return what this Forge session can do (workspace, Git, secrets, previews, approvals).

forge_observer_workspaces.title: Observer: list workspaces
forge_observer_workspaces.description: Read-only snapshot of live workspace slots, tasks, and branch state for operator visibility. Does not mutate sandboxes.

forge_observer_workspace.title: Observer: workspace detail
forge_observer_workspace.description: Read-only observer bundle: processes, merged MCP tool trail, log tail. Same data as /app/live for one workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_observer_activity.title: Observer: tool activity
forge_observer_activity.description: Read-only trail of MCP tool calls for this account. payloads:true returns what each call actually sent and received (secrets redacted, large values previewed); errors_only:true narrows to failures. Use it to see why agents are failing rather than only that they failed.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_repository_list.title: List repositories
forge_repository_list.description: List GitHub repositories authorized for this account. No container.

forge_task_create.title: Create task
forge_task_create.description: Create a durable task (goal, decisions, non-goals). Call before opening a workspace for coherent work.

repository.description: Authorized GitHub repository to act on.

forge_task_get.title: Get task
forge_task_get.description: Get a task. mode=full (default), summary (compact resume), or resume (task + workspace + git + handoff in one call).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_task_list.title: List tasks
forge_task_list.description: List recent tasks, optionally filtered by state or query.

forge_task_update.title: Update task
forge_task_update.description: Finish a task (outcome) and/or record a handoff for the next session.

expected_revision.description: Fails if the workspace moved on past this revision.

forge_workspace_create.title: Create workspace
forge_workspace_create.description: Create an isolated workspace from an authorized repo. Checks out ref (default main) then auto-creates forge/<id> so agents never edit main. Waits until ready by default.

repository.description: Authorized GitHub repository to act on.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_workspace_get.title: Get workspace
forge_workspace_get.description: Compact workspace summary including branch_policy (must be on forge/). Prefer compact:true in ChatGPT.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_workspace_destroy.title: Destroy workspace
forge_workspace_destroy.description: Tear down the workspace. Refused if unpushed forge/ commits exist unless force:true.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

expected_revision.description: Fails if the workspace moved on past this revision.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_operation_get.title: Get operation
forge_operation_get.description: After a disconnect or unknown tool outcome, check whether operation op_... finished, failed, or is still active.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_workspace_snapshot.title: Snapshot workspace
forge_workspace_snapshot.description: Capture a named checkpoint of the workspace filesystem. Use before risky operations to enable rollback.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_workspace_restore.title: Restore snapshot
forge_workspace_restore.description: Roll back the workspace to a previous checkpoint. Destroys uncommitted work. Returns the restored state.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

expected_revision.description: Fails if the workspace moved on past this revision.

forge_files_list.title: List files
forge_files_list.description: List a bounded file tree under /workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_files_read.title: Read files
forge_files_read.description: Read one file (path) or several (paths) with content hashes for conflict-safe edits.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_edit.title: Edit files
forge_edit.description: Edit files. Committed straight to GitHub on your branch — no push, nothing left only in the workspace. Prefer replace: [{old,new}] and send only the fragment you are changing; Forge reads the current file and applies it. Use content for a whole new file, or content:null to delete. Returns the commit URL.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_diff_metadata.title: Diff metadata
forge_diff_metadata.description: Syntax-only metadata over the outgoing diff: changed symbols, secret risk, file classification, and suggested hunks. No model, no semantics — an index into the diff, not a substitute.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_context_get.title: Get context
forge_context_get.description: Deterministic repo-context selection for a goal. Returns ranked file paths with reasons, adjacent tests, governing instructions, and confidence scores. Does NOT return file contents — use forge_files_read for that.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_shell.title: Run command
forge_shell.description: Run a command in the workspace. Anything expected to take over ~45s runs in the background and returns a process_id to wait on, because a client will not hold a request open longer. compact defaults true: returns exitCode + short tails; full stdout/stderr spill to output_artifact_id when >20KB (forge_artifact_get). async:true for long work. Risky commands need approval_id.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

cwd.description: Working directory inside the workspace; must start with /workspace.

expected_revision.description: Fails if the workspace moved on past this revision.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_process_list.title: List processes
forge_process_list.description: List managed processes. Pass process_id to get one process in detail.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_process_wait.title: Wait for process
forge_process_wait.description: Wait for a managed process to finish, or time out. Timeouts are observational (process is NOT killed) and return timedOut:true with suggestedTimeoutMs — retry with a larger timeout_ms (use >=600000 for large installs). Do not restart the command.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_process_logs.title: Process logs
forge_process_logs.description: Read new log bytes after an opaque cursor. Pass nextCursor until hasMore is false.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_process_stop.title: Stop process
forge_process_stop.description: Stop a managed process. force:true cancels harder (SIGTERM then SIGKILL).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

expected_revision.description: Fails if the workspace moved on past this revision.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_deps_install.title: Install dependencies
forge_deps_install.description: Start dependency install as a managed process. If still running, returns processId — call forge_process_wait with timeout_ms >= 600000. Do not start a second install.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

expected_revision.description: Fails if the workspace moved on past this revision.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_pr.title: Pull requests
forge_pr.description: List pull requests, read one’s real merge readiness (checks, reviews, mergeable state), merge it, or close it. status is the one to call before merging — it answers whether merging is safe. Merging re-checks live, so a green result read earlier cannot authorise a merge of newer commits.

forge_access.title: Repository access
forge_access.description: Why Forge can or cannot reach a repository: which repositories this account has authorized, and for one repo whether the GitHub App is installed and what it can do. Call this when a Git operation fails with a permission error, before assuming the transport is broken.

forge_history.title: Commit history
forge_history.description: Recent commits on a branch, or the history of one file. Returns sha, message, author and date — not diffs. Use it to see how a file got to its current state without cloning anything.

forge_branches.title: List or delete branches
forge_branches.description: List a repository’s branches with whether each is already merged into the default branch, or delete one. Deleting refuses the default branch always, and refuses an unmerged branch unless you pass force with a reason. merged_only:true deletes every merged branch in one call.

forge_merge.title: Merge for review
forge_merge.description: Ask the human to merge your work. Opens a pull request from your branch and returns one approval link — echo the link, do not invent URLs. Your branch is already on GitHub; nothing is pushed here.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_cloudflare_deploy.title: Deploy to Cloudflare
forge_cloudflare_deploy.description: Deploy with wrangler using an attached Cloudflare vault secret (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID). Returns deploy_receipt; full logs spill to output_artifact_id. Do not claim live without verified_url.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

cwd.description: Working directory inside the workspace; must start with /workspace.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_review.title: Review URL
forge_review.description: Screenshot any public URL (no container). Returns images in this call.

forge_preview_expose.title: Expose preview
forge_preview_expose.description: Expose a running process through a short-lived Forge preview URL. Private by default; public access needs approval.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

expected_revision.description: Fails if the workspace moved on past this revision.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_preview.title: Preview capture
forge_preview.description: Screenshot your workspace app. Omit preview_id and Forge starts/exposes the dev server. Optional steps drive click/fill before the shot.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_artifact_get.title: Get artifact
forge_artifact_get.description: Fetch a stored artifact (images returned as MCP image content).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_artifact_upload.title: Upload artifact
forge_artifact_upload.description: Upload a binary file as a stored artifact. Pass base64-encoded content. Returns artifact id for later retrieval.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.

forge_secret_list.title: List secrets
forge_secret_list.description: List stored secrets (labels, providers, env var names). Values never returned.

forge_secret_create.title: Create secret
forge_secret_create.description: Store env vars as a labeled secret. Encrypted at rest; values never returned.

env.description: Environment variable key-value pairs to store.

forge_secret_update.title: Update secret
forge_secret_update.description: Update label, provider, or env vars.

env.description: Environment variable key-value pairs to store.

forge_secret_delete.title: Delete secret
forge_secret_delete.description: Permanently delete a secret and detach it from workspaces.

forge_secret_attach.title: Attach or detach secret
forge_secret_attach.description: Attach (default) or detach (attached:false) a secret on a workspace. Attach requires human approval.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit to use your open one.
